_doc: Strategic partners powered by SOMIN. Each runs SOMIN's platform for its own clients (their cloud.<domain> deployments report into the somin.ai GA4 property) or builds on SOMIN's team and research. 'short' is the 2-4 word line on the home-page plate; 'description' is the Vision-page card and schema text. Write descriptions from the partner's own website only. Rendered by <!--mm:partners--> (Vision page, #partners) and <!--mm:partners compact="1"--> (home hero plate).

items.name: ToucHigh
items.description: Gets Chinese cross-border sellers cited by US AI answer engines such as ChatGPT and Perplexity, and automates their US social posts, articles and ads. Co-founded by SOMIN's CTO, Kirill Lepikhin.

items.name: Defy
items.description: An AI insight and automation platform that gives independent agencies and in-house brand teams competitor, audience and conversation intelligence, with Claude-native tools and agentic workflows.

items.name: Matrex Analytica
items.description: Runs its client platform on SOMIN.

items.name: Voltage X AI
items.description: An Australia-based company that combines AI with marketing: digital marketing, PR, branding and a smart-marketing SaaS tool for clients across industries.

items.name: Gordon Glenister
items.description: London-based influencer marketing strategist and author who helps brands, organisations and leaders build authority, grow their audiences and get measurable results.
